title: Awful Bliss Auto
concept: A solitary wanderer navigates a series of decaying, elemental landscapes that reflect the weight of past decisions.
style: A recurring figure appears throughout: A middle-aged individual wearing a heavy, oversized wool coat in charcoal gray..

scenes.lead: Oxidized copper relief panel in raking light:
scenes.style: Hammered copper sheet with deep verdigris green patina, mineral crust, corroded pitting, raised repoussé forms catching the light, aged metal. No photorealism — the material and process are the subject.
scenes.still_prompt: An abandoned shipyard filled with massive, corroded iron hulls and oxidizing copper plates.
beats: Wide shot: The figure stands motionless beside a massive green-crusted anchor.
Close-up: The figure traces a finger along a jagged edge of oxidized metal.
Medium shot: The figure walks slowly through a narrow gap between two rusted shipping containers.
Low angle shot: The figure looks up at the towering, peeling metal structures.
Over-the-shoulder shot: The figure stares out at the dark, churning water beyond the scrap heap.
scenes.video_prompt: Heavy salt spray mist drifts through the structural gaps. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: A slow, drifting pan across the textured metal surfaces.
motion.mid: A steady tracking shot following the figure from a distance.
motion.high: Rapid whip pans between the sharp angles of the rusted iron.

scenes.style: Leaded came dividing saturated colored glass, luminous jewel tones, glass texture and trapped bubbles, heavy dark lead lines, medieval craft. No photorealism — the material and process are the subject.
scenes.still_prompt: A ruined cathedral nave where fragmented, colorful glass shards litter the stone floor.
beats: Extreme wide shot: The figure enters through a broken archway into the light-streaked hall.
Medium shot: The figure steps carefully over a pile of vibrant blue and red glass fragments.
Close-up: The figure's hand reaches toward a single shard reflecting a spectrum of light.
Medium shot: The figure spins in the center of a kaleidoscope of colors.
Low angle shot: The figure collapses onto the stone floor surrounded by light.
scenes.video_prompt: Dust motes dance intensely within the shafts of colored light. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: A creeping dolly shot toward the altar.
motion.mid: A rhythmic handheld movement following the figure's steps.
motion.high: A frantic, circular tracking shot around the central figure.

scenes.lead: Cyanotype sun print on rough cotton rag paper:
scenes.style: Deep Prussian blue and raw paper white only, brush-stroked emulsion edges, fibrous paper grain visible throughout, high contrast with no midtones, hand-coated unevenness. No photorealism — the material and process are the subject.
scenes.still_prompt: A vast, empty library filled with blue-tinted parchment and shadows.
beats: Wide shot: The figure sits at a heavy wooden desk in the center of the blue hall.
Medium shot: The figure flips through a thick book of monochromatic blueprints.
Close-up: The figure closes their eyes and leans their head back against the chair.
Medium shot: The figure stands and walks toward a wall of blue-tinted archives.
Extreme long shot: The figure becomes a small silhouette against the deep blue expanse.
scenes.video_prompt: A fine layer of frost settles slowly on the wooden surfaces. The material texture of the image stays constant and visible throughout.

motion.low: A slow, vertical tilt from floor to ceiling.
motion.mid: A smooth gliding shot down the length of the aisle.
motion.high: A sudden, sharp zoom toward the figure's face.
